title: no AI wand
description: An wand that turn off AI of mobs
body: This datapack is very simple. You have to trow nether star on stick, and that's pretty much it. If you hold wand in your hand, you notice particles around you. If **any** entity if touching these particles it will lose it's AI. Works by executing command **/Data merge entity @e[distance=..3] {NoAI:1B}**
